title: backlog.py cost: an open session's figures count windows of items with no item file, which distill no longer does
goal: bl_cost.open_lines passes ql_distill.item_finder(Path(root) / REL_DIR) to ql_distill.work_windows and ql_distill.plan_work, so the figures of a still-open session use the windows distill gives once it closes (a claim or branch row of an item with no item file, that no later done or release row closes, opens none, BG-m6fknqr5), and backlog.md's Cost of work says so; the repro (a spool with one branch row of an item that has no file in the backlog directory of a fixture root) exits 0

run: import os,sys,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ["CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA"]=str(t/"d");os.environ["CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"]=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_capture as q,bl_cost as b;q.record("prompt","s1",prompt_id="p1",prompt="x");q.record("work","s1",prompt_id="p1",action="branch",item="ST-aaaaaaaa");lines,info=b.open_lines(t);print(info);sys.exit(1 if info else 0)
